reader_summary.headline: Consumer software may have adopted and incorporated AI ahead of enterprise software, where the data is more proprietary.
reader_summary.overview: Consumer software may have adopted and incorporated AI ahead of enterprise software, where the data is more proprietary. But recently AI has found its way into B2B, and it is rapidly transforming how we work and the software we use. In this episode, Das Rush interviews Oleg Rogynskyy, founder of People.ai , an AI platform for sales and marketers.
